Panda Menu: Discover the Full Chinese Dining Experience at Panda Express

In the evolving landscape of takeout and delivery, the Panda menu stands out as one of the most comprehensive and flavorful collections of Chinese food offerings in the United States. Whether you are planning a quick lunch special, a cozy dinner at home, or a cater event for a celebration, Panda Express provides a diverse selection of delicious dishes that appeal to all taste preferences. This guide explores everything from appetizers to specialty entrées, along with side orders, beverages, and more. You’ll also learn how to order online, view menu items online from Panda, and explore best Chinese meal options for delivery or pickup.

Appetizer Selections at Panda Express

Start your Panda experience with enticing appetizers that are crispy, hot, and bursting with flavor. Appetizers are often the most anticipated part of the meal, and Panda delivers just the right mix.

Appetizer Item Description Price (USD)
Chicken Egg Roll Crispy roll with chicken & veggies $2.20
Veggie Spring Roll Assorted vegetables, light wrapper $2.00
Cream Cheese Rangoons Cream cheese in fried wonton skin $2.30
Fried Shrimp Lightly breaded and seasoned shrimp $3.50

Panda’s egg rolls, spring rolls, and fried shrimp offer a crispy, hot, and satisfying way to begin your meal. These items are often paired with special sauces such as sweet chili or plum.

Chicken Dishes – The Heart of Panda’s Menu

Chicken is a cornerstone of many popular Panda Express dishes. From orange chicken to spicy kung pao, the poultry options are fresh, tender, and full of special flavor combinations.

Panda Chicken Menu Highlights

Chicken Dish Description Price (USD)
Orange Chicken Crispy chicken with sweet orange sauce $7.80
Kung Pao Chicken Spicy stir-fry with peanuts and peppers $7.50
Mushroom Chicken Sautéed chicken with mushrooms and zucchini $7.50
Sweet & Sour Chicken Battered chicken in sweet sour sauce $7.80

From sweet to sour, from mild to spicy, chicken items dominate the menu due to their crowd-pleasing appeal. The orange and mushroom chicken in particular are popular choices for both dine-in and delivery customers.

Beef and Pork Selections – Savory and Satisfying

Beef Dishes

Beef Dish Description Price (USD)
Broccoli Beef Tender beef with steamed broccoli $8.00
Beijing Beef Crispy beef in sweet-tangy sauce $8.20
Black Pepper Angus Marinated beef with onions and bell peppers $8.50

Pork Items

Pork Dish Description Price (USD)
Sweet & Sour Pork Pork cubes in tangy sweet sauce $7.90
BBQ Pork Chinese-style roasted pork slices $8.20

These beef and pork items are stir-fried to perfection with assorted vegetables and special sauces that enhance every bite. These hearty dishes make excellent choices for a complete Chinese restaurant meal experience.

Seafood at Panda – Light Yet Flavorful

If you’re in the mood for something lighter, Panda’s seafood options are worth exploring.

Seafood Dish Description Price (USD)
Fried Shrimp Breaded shrimp with tangy sauce $8.50
Shrimp with Lobster Sauce Shrimp in a savory egg-white sauce $9.00
Sweet & Sour Shrimp Lightly battered with tangy sweet sauce $8.80

Each shrimp dish is seasoned and cooked to enhance its natural sweetness, providing a delicious, crispy, and satisfying meal.

Chow Mein and Lo Mein – Noodle Lovers Rejoice

Noodle dishes like chow mein, lo mein, and chow fun are essential in any Chinese food menu.

Noodle Dish Description Price (USD)
Chow Mein Stir-fried wheat noodles with veggies $6.90
Lo Mein Soft noodles with vegetables $7.00
Chow Fun Wide rice noodles with meat or tofu $7.50
Mei Fun Thin rice noodles with mixed vegetables $7.50
Mai Fun Singapore-style curried noodles $7.80

From chow mein to mei fun, these noodle dishes are perfect for pairing with a protein or enjoyed as a la carte meal.

Fried Rice, Egg Foo Young, and Vegetable Sides

Fried Rice Options

Fried Rice Description Price (USD)
Classic Fried Rice Rice with eggs, peas, carrots $6.50
Chicken Fried Rice Rice with diced chicken & veggies $7.00
Shrimp Fried Rice Rice with shrimp and egg $7.50

Egg Foo Young

Egg Foo Young Description Price (USD)
Chicken Foo Young Egg patties with chicken and veggies $7.80
Shrimp Foo Young With shrimp and bean sprouts $8.20

Vegetable-Based Dishes

Vegetable Dish Description Price (USD)
Stir-Fried Greens Seasonal green vegetables $6.20
Mixed Vegetables Assorted stir-fried garden veggies $6.50
Tofu with Veggies Fried tofu with steamed broccoli $6.80

Soups and Hot Dishes to Warm the Soul

A bowl of soup is the perfect comfort food. Panda’s hot offerings combine simplicity with flavor.

Soup Dish Description Price (USD)
Hot & Sour Soup Spicy broth with tofu and mushrooms $3.50
Egg Drop Soup Silky egg ribbons in savory broth $3.00
Wonton Soup Dumplings in a clear chicken broth $3.80

These soups provide warmth and balance to a rich meal, offering a diet-friendly option with nourishing ingredients.

Specialty & Chef’s Signature Dishes

Panda’s specialty dishes reflect culinary craftsmanship and authentic Chinese flavors.

Specialty Dish Description Price (USD)
Chef’s Special Chicken Seasonal chicken with house sauce $9.00
Dragon Scallop Scallops stir-fried with chili garlic $9.50
Crispy Duck Roasted duck with crispy skin $10.00

These chef’s specialties are unique items designed for those looking for something extraordinary.

Lunch Specials and Combination Plates

Lunch specials at Panda are designed for value and variety. You can enjoy combinations of entrées with fried rice, chow mein, or vegetables.

Combo Meal Includes Price (USD)
2-Item Combo Any 2 entrees + 1 side $9.50
3-Item Combo Any 3 entrees + 1 side $11.00
Lunch Special Bowl 1 entrée + rice/noodle $6.50

Each combination is customizable, allowing you to try different menu items online from Panda at once.

Side Orders and A La Carte Options

Side Order Description Price (USD)
Steamed White Rice Fluffy long-grain rice $2.50
Brown Rice Healthier grain-rich option $2.80
Steamed Broccoli Green, fresh steamed veggie $2.50

A la carte selections are ideal for those who want to customize meals or share among family.

Beverages and Desserts

Round out your meal with a refreshing beverage or a sweet treat.

Beverage or Dessert Description Price (USD)
Iced Green Tea Unsweetened, refreshing $2.20
Lemonade Tangy, fresh-squeezed $2.50
Fortune Cookies Classic end to a Chinese meal $1.00

Order Online for Delivery or Takeout

Panda makes it easy to order all menu items online, whether you’re at home or at work. Their user-friendly website and app let you browse menu items online from Panda, add favorites to your cart, and schedule delivery or takeout with ease.

To understand how online food ordering systems work and how they benefit customers and businesses, you can read this overview from the National Restaurant Association.

Panda for Events – Catering and Group Orders

Panda also offers cater packages for large gatherings. This includes trays of chow mein, fried rice, and multiple entrée options. It’s perfect for birthdays, office parties, or school events.

Learn more about the health safety standards in food catering from CDC’s food safety guidelines.

Craving a wider variety of pizzas, subs, wings, and unbeatable combo deals? Explore the full Pizza King menu for a delicious and budget-friendly guide.

Why Choose Panda for Your Next Meal?

  • A wide variety of Chinese food that includes meat, vegetable, and seafood items

  • Affordable pricing with combination meals and lunch deals

  • Quick delivery and takeout options through online ordering

  • A brand trusted for quality and consistency

For more on Chinese cuisine and its rich culinary history, visit China Highlights’ guide to Chinese food.

Final Thoughts – Explore the Panda Chinese Restaurant Experience

Whether you’re craving spicy Szechuan beef, creamy egg foo young, or the classic orange chicken, the Panda menu delivers a robust and delicious selection of Chinese food. With simple options to order online, schedule takeout, or get it delivered straight to your door, Panda remains one of the best Chinese options available for every kind of diner.

Explore the Panda Chinese dining experience today and make your next meal a celebration of flavor, freshness, and tradition.
